title: InsideEVs: Ford Mustang Mach-E fast charging analysis
notes: Separate 2021 First Edition Extended Range AWD session (Electrify America, 0-100 %, initial firmware): peak 159 kW almost immediately, about 112 kW at 7-10 %, 106-107 kW at 11-27 %, 95-97 kW at 31-37 %, 76-80 kW at 40-77 %, about 12 kW above 80 %. Used only as a shape cross-check.
